7 0 0 0 0 0 0 2 7 7 7 7 0 0 0 0'''
T=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()] for l in test_s.splitlines()]);
# connected components of !=7 under 4-neighborhood
from collections import deque
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(16):
 for c in range(16):
  if T[r,c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
   while q:
    p=q.popleft(); cells.append(p)
    for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
     z=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
     if 0<=z[0]<16 and 0<=z[1]<16 and z not in seen and T[z]!=7:
      seen.add(z); q.append(z)
   comps.append(cells)
for i, cells in enumerate(comps):
 rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]; colors=sorted(set(T[p] for p in cells));
 print(i, (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)),len(cells), colors, 'special?',set([8,2,4]).issubset(colors), '3?',3 in colors)
